prediction: archive.ts exports ArchiveErrorReason, ArchiveError(reason), UnreadablePhotoError(photoId), OpenedArchive with expectedCrc, and archivableAlbum, archiveFileName, assertFitsArchive, crc32OfBlob, buildArchive, isZip, readArchive, nameKey, freeName, isPlainName, archivablePhotos, writeInSlices, saveArchiveBlob.
archivableAlbum uses photoUsage, keeps cover and unprinted-half photos, makes names unique without regard to case, sets lastFileSaveAt to savedAt, and does not mutate its input.
assertFitsArchive refuses totals with a header margin at the ZIP limit, and more than 65,535 entries, with album.json counted as an entry.
crc32OfBlob, verify and the reader use Blob.slice, with no whole-file read and no fflate import.

buildArchive puts album.json first as serializeLayout output, takes each photo size from its file, writes photos/<name> stored with flag bit 11, and gives UnreadablePhotoError on a read failure and on a missing map entry.

readArchive scans back for the end record, tolerates a comment, reads the central directory and follows the local header. Only stored entries pass. Bounds checks give zip. parseLayout gives LayoutFileError. No photos array, a slash or backslash in a name, no entry, and another size each give content.

layoutFile.ts exports safeBaseName, downloadBlob, PickerWindow with showDirectoryPicker. openLayoutFile is replaced by pickAlbumFile accepting .json and .zip. parseLayout is unchanged. saveLayoutFile behaviour is unchanged.

Tests run in the node environment, read output with unzipSync, compare CRC with node:zlib, compare sha256, compare local and central headers, and cover each Completion Criterion clause, writeInSlices, freeName, a 3 MB read-side memory test and a table of reader refusals.

Risks named beforehand: name byte length against UTF-16 length, 32-bit overflow in CRC, wrong header offsets, whole-file read in verify, offsets out of the file, comment handling, freeName collisions, and names such as .. or empty.
